Stale counts the projects, directories and files of the index (or of
--project) by freshness (fresh, seed, stale, none), lists those that are
stale or have no summary at all, most important first, and the
backticked references in docs that resolve to no indexed path (doc
drift).

Usage:
  agent index stale [flags]

Examples:
  agent index stale
  agent index stale --project alpha --limit 20

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for stale
      --json             Print the counts and lists as JSON
      --limit int        At most this many of each list (default 50)
      --project string   Only this project

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
